claims: Instruction-count scope only. No rustc wall-time, linker, whole-Cargo or whole-dev-loop gain claimed.
endpoint: isolated replay of an actual ordinary uv library-test cached Cargo relink after the genuine uv-client one-byte comment edit
input_policy: Exact same portable captured rlink/object/dependency/source/runtime-tool bytes, modes and file mtimes at identical absolute paths. Separate private complete arm banks; selected writable unit reset from the same pristine image before every sample. Actual ordered rustc argv/environment unchanged.

jobserver.limitation: uncontested standalone replay; not reconstruction of original Cargo-parent concurrent token availability

maintenance.scope: only before entry/complete pairs; unavailable deadlines wait; strict sample guards unchanged

metric: complete rustc process Callgrind Ir, all rustc threads combined
native_child_scope: cc, collect2 and Wild execute natively; their instructions are outside this metric
occupancy: Original strict require_quiet at entry and before/after every sampled command. Post-restoration activity observational only.
output_policy: Exact original full ELF SHA256, size and mode; exact native stdout/stderr; unchanged rlink/object inputs; seven jobserver tokens returned. No ELF masks or hash exceptions.
public_derivative: Only private host/service names are replaced; all workload, scope, order, count, seed, gate and restoration rules are retained.
raw_gate: Authenticate complete restoration, all 16 samples, source/runtime/input/output/occupancy guards and raw/gzip identities before decoding effects. Then require final profile totals == sum of exclusive self costs == Valgrind stderr Collected count.
replication: Independent dedicated VM, same CPU class and placement. Exact portable input image from the real host1 Cargo capture; no new Cargo namespace is synthesized for host2. Host/system tools independently bound and native output parity required. Blocks reported separately, never pooled.
runtime_treatment: defer only sorted Rust library-file inventory for link-only; native resolution/linker remain live
selected_role: ordinary uv library-test cached relink (preferred role present)
stop: A valid failed block stops qualification. Operational failure excludes the whole attempt before effects and requires separate prospective replacement authority. No pair deletion or extension.
